comparator.name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 example combines 60 EC of General Education, a 67.5 EC media main direction and 52.5 EC of profiling space. The media direction includes the Doing Media Heritage package, preparation, a research seminar, an approved direction elective and a final paper. General Education includes a separate interdisciplinary paper. Students also maintain a portfolio.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The media plan responds to Utrecht’s interdisciplinary structure and current media direction through media history, representation, documentary, audiences, research and social science. The sustainability plan combines environmental systems with policy and justice. The digital society plan combines AI methods with media and social inquiry. A fourth culture and global society direction has supporting courses in culture, politics, inequality and identity, and shares much of the broad media option’s focus. The comparison already presents three distinct options.
